notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control a basic Plains.
description:
Cast Squadron Hawk by paying {1}{W}.
When Squadron Hawk enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping Squadron Hawk, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squadron Hawk and putting it on the bottom of your library, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Squadron Hawk's trigger, searching your library for a card named Squadron Hawk and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.
